1263-2301-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-2921-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-955-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-955-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1402-3593-4359-5315.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

2150-2281-2921.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2440-3499-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3499-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

539-2416-3899-4552-5902.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5775-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5775-6913-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
5775-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Chameleon, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Chameleon. Choose to have Chameleon enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

671-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Myr Scrapling enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1805-4067-4477-6281.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

1976-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1976-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

546-4499-5508.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ramos.
When Ramos enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler and Emiel trigger.
Resolve the Railway Brawler trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on Ramos.
Resolve the Emiel trigger, causing you to pay {G/W} to put a +1/+1 counter on Ramos.
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4050-5544-6431.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 2.
Repeat.

997-5434-5541-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
997-5434-5541-5555.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

478-2821-3664-3918-5873.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3664-3918-5873.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{B}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Everglades.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

1458-3459--44.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
1458-3459--44.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Battered Golem.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
When the artifact enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, returning the artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4651-5280-5919.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
4651-5280-5919.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

4624-5755.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}, doubling your life total and causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Enduring Tenacity's first ability triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

779-833-2092-2546.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

380-703-2557.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Parallel Lives that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating an extremely large number of Parallel Lives tokens that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.

2719-2781.description:
Cast Sakashima of a Thousand Faces either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1374-1785-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Knight that can be cast using only black mana.
1374-1785-2178.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing any other nontoken Knight that can be cast using only black mana, adding an amount of {B} equal to that creature's mana value.
The Knight dies, triggering Soldevi Adnate, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
The Knight enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1738-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 9.
1738-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Serra Avatar.
Mayael's Aria then triggers, gaining you ten life, causing Serra Avatar's power to be at least twenty.
Mayael's Aria triggers, winning you the game.

with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-736-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Copy Enchantment trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

1256-4289-4893-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
